The '''Djurmo system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] found in the [[Strabin sector/Legends|Strabin sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Djurmo]].
